name: Elegant Parrot
rangeDescription: Disjunct in southwestern and south-central australia, including kangaroo island
description: Handsome small parrot of southern Australia. Yellowish-green overall, with yellow underbelly, green back, green head, and thin dark blue patch on folded wing.

name: Black-and-white Monjita
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (paraná) to paraguay, uruguay, and northeastern argentina
description: Large, slim flycatcher with a fairly long tail. Males are mostly white with black wings and tail.

name: Madagascar Blue-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Humid forest of eastern madagascar
description: Medium-sized chunky pigeon that is dark blue with a maroon tail. Appears short-tailed in flight.

name: Bay-breasted Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Hispaniola and gonâve island
description: A large cuckoo with an impressive tail and a rich maroon throat and breast. Found in low-to-moderate elevation deciduous woodlands.

name: Jelski's Black-Tyrant
rangeDescription: East slope of andes from southeastern ecuador (zamora-chinchipe) southward to central peru (to junín)
description: Rare flycatcher found in cloud forest along the east slope of the Andes in northern and central Peru, barely reaching over the border into southeastern Ecuador. Male is dark sooty gray; female is grayish-olive with pale wingbars and faint streaking below.

name: Dusky Lory
rangeDescription: New guinea, including salawati (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea) and yapen (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: Fairly large lory of lowlands and foothill forest and edge. Mainly dark plumage, with 2 obvious bands across the chest and a red bill.

name: Spot-backed Antshrike
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil to eastern paraguay and far northeastern argentina (misiones)
description: Chunky antshrike with a long tail and heavy bill with a hooked tip. Males are spotted black and white above (buffier in females) and brownish below with a barred tail.

name: Cameroon Mountain Greenbul
rangeDescription: Montane forest of nigeria and cameroon
description: A medium-sized greenbul of the mountains of Cameroon and southeastern Nigeria. Remarkably uniform yellow-olive in plumage, with a red eye.

name: Allpahuayo Antbird
rangeDescription: Northeastern peru north of río marañón (río morona to río nanay drainage)
description: Scarce antbird described to science in 2001. It is found in lowland rainforest in northeastern Peru, only in areas with white, sandy soil.

name: Hudson's Canastero
rangeDescription: Far southern brazil to uruguay and eastern argentina (south to río negro)
description: Distinctive, heavily streaked ovenbird with a long spiky tail. Note the thin black streaks on the flanks.

name: Sichuan Thrush
rangeDescription: Breeds south-central china (central sichuan); winter range poorly known, but reported from northern vietnam (tonkin)
description: Little-known thrush which breeds in the dense hilly and montane forests of China’s northern and central Sichuan province; favors dense understory and coniferous stands. Brown above with scaled white underparts.

name: Helmeted Hornbill
rangeDescription: Myanmar to southern thailand, malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Bizarre-looking bird, now very rare due to poaching for the ivory-like material of its bill. When perched, its most recognizable feature is the naked throat pouch which resembles an undercooked steak, chalky white in the female and dull scarlet in the male.

name: Fulvous-breasted Flatbill
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia and far western venezuela to western bolivia
description: Scarce, inconspicuous flycatcher of Andean cloud forest. It has olive upperparts, tawny breast, yellow belly, gray eyering, and brown patches in wings.

name: Sao Tome Pigeon
rangeDescription: São tomé, príncipe, and annobón (gulf of guinea)
description: A small-to-medium-sized dark pigeon with slaty wings, a grayish head and breast, an iridescent green-pink sheen on the mantle, a buffy vent, and red feet. Sexes differ in plumage: male has a gray belly and female has a buff-rufous belly.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Mindoro Cuckooshrike
rangeDescription: West-central philippines (mindoro, libagao, and tablas)
description: Sleek but sturdy gray bird with fierce pale eyes, endemic to the west-central Philippine islands of Mindoro, Libagao, and Tablas. Male is uniform overall, but darker on the tail, wingtips, and between the eye and bill.

name: Rote Boobook
rangeDescription: Rote (lesser sundas)
description: Found only in forested areas on Rote Island, this medium-sized brown owl is physically all but identical to several closely-related species spread out across Indonesia and Australasia; fortunately, no others are present on Rote. Note the bright yellow eyes, speckled underparts, and large round head characteristic of the Boobooks.

name: Pemba White-eye
rangeDescription: Pemba island (off northeastern tanzania)
description: A small, sharp-billed warbler-like bird with bright yellow underparts, an olive-yellow back, black lores, and very narrow white spectacles around the eyes. Common in nearly all habitats on the island of Pemba, including gardens, scrub, plantations, woodland, and forest edge.

name: African Sacred Ibis
rangeDescription: Sub-saharan africa and southeastern iraq; formerly egypt
description: Striking white ibis with a naked black head and neck and black legs and feet. White wings framed by black wingtips and trailing edges.

name: Black-lored Parrot
rangeDescription: Montane forest of buru (southern moluccas)
description: A big green parrot with a large orange bill, a thin black line between bill and eye, and uniform green wings. Confined to the island of Buru, where it is found in upper levels of forest in foothills and mountains.

name: Papuan Dwarf-Kingfisher
rangeDescription: New guinea, including raja ampat islands (off western new guinea), aru islands (off southwestern new guinea), and d'entrecasteaux archipelago (off southeastern new guinea)
description: A tiny kingfisher of lowland and foothill forest interior. Deep, cobalt blue head and wings with eye-catching paler blue patch on the back and pale orange belly.
